pages.title: First Foundation
pages.text: This is the first chalk in the journey of any occultist. Due to its simplicity, it serves as a$(br) weak foundation. Pentacles drawn only with this chalk attract only the weakest spirits,$(br) known as Folit.$(br)
In almost any pentacle where you see a white glyph, it can be replaced with another$(br) "colorless" chalk (light gray, gray, or black).$(br)
